items.claim: Marino Spacic lacks great pace and striking abilities.
items.quote: I don't think she's got great pace. I don't think she's got great striking abilities.

items.claim: Stephanie Luchiano does not tire and puts up a high volume pace in the later rounds.
items.quote: Luciano does not tire. And when you cannot take her down, she really puts up a high volume pace fight.

items.claim: Stephanie Luchiano struggles against bigger, stronger physical fighters who can rough her up and take her down.
items.quote: It's the against bigger, stronger physical fighters that can rough her up and take her down is where she has troubles.

items.claim: Stephanie Luchiano's ground game has improved offensively, leading to a submission win in her last outing.
items.quote: You saw her improved ground game. Now she's offensively getting takedowns, ends up getting the rear naked choke in the third round.

items.claim: Marina Spacic lost to a 5-2 regional fighter two fights ago.
items.quote: She lost to a 5-2 regional fighter just two fights ago.
